feature.name: Generate the agent spec bundle
feature.description: Manifest and small chunks per feature, component and interface group, with ids, contracts, objects, acceptance with verify and code anchors.

requirements.text: Unresolved validation issues are part of the bundle next to the affected feature
Fields marked x-audience: human are left out

acceptance.text: The manifest lists entries with their issues; chunks carry agent fields only, with resolved objects
An agent reads the manifest and one chunk through MCP get_spec

decisions.decision: One bundle per project: every live feature, object and workflow
decisions.reason: Answers Q1. Scoped bundles (component, release by tickets) are PRODUCTCREATOR-38

decisions.decision: Chunk budget 16 KB; a larger chunk is flagged overBudget in the manifest
decisions.reason: Answers Q2. An agent loads one chunk per task; the flag shows entries to split
